The '''''Archer''''' was a [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|CR92a ''Assassin''-class corvette]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ship was piloted by [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Nanda (ensign)|Nanda]] during [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] five-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] mission to punish every person responsible for the infiltration of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Kell Bircher]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
